args.description: bash: command, optional accepted_exit_codes; probe/search: query; read: file, optional positive offset/limit (lines); skeleton/ingest: file; expand: id; ingest: optional table; query: sql, optional file to import as its basename without extension (spaces/hyphens become underscores). SQL numbers require CAST. Values can be $ref objects.

input.description: Decision state or extraction text. Values can reference earlier outputs.

items.description: Group items array or $ref to an array.

template.description: Group child node; item and index are supplied in its input.

returns.description: Paths /nodes/id/output for a whole output or /nodes/id/output/field. Fields: stdout, stderr, exit_code, status, or tool data such as body, rows, table, answer, or an extracted label.
